executionRequirement: 要么完成本卡当前约定范围及本角色必要检查，要么遇到确实无法继续的具体问题才停止；不能做一点就停下。

record.payload: raw useful argument/return evidence with lossless dictionary, SHA and checked byte lengths
record.overflow: INCOMPLETE; first missing sequence and counters; no overwrite

tester: fixed 52-action owner checkpoint scheduling, exact attribution of remaining work
lossless sink, all original GL call evidence and no added calls in primary arms
join real accepted-root completion, ledger, token, raw errors and terminal state by exact scope
full primary arms with hash-bound receipts and matched raw evidence runs
developer: only host-fixture build seam after actual owner acceptance/fence and before buffer reuse
borrow safe bank/event map checks without widening production Freeze eligibility

measurement.primary: same PE/mode/seed/input except capture control. No additional per-root GL readback.
measurement.raw: evidence replay OFF/ON; borrow real accepts and current owner state bytes with checked n*256, compare every root and compare replay milestones back to primary arms
measurement.qualification: any mismatch, dropped rows or incomplete raw evidence stays NOT_MEASURED
